title: Command & Conquer: Renegade
notes: Mission achievements also unlock from your save games: save once in each new mission and the one before it counts, even if Vault was closed while you played.
Mission achievements unlock when the score screen after a campaign mission appears.
Playing a single mission from "Replay level" does not count, only the campaign.

watches.label: Campaign step (-10 = not in the campaign)

testGuide.title: Start Renegade
testGuide.detail: Click Play on the game page and wait for the main menu.

testGuide.title: Start a new campaign
testGuide.detail: Single player → New Game → pick a difficulty. "Campaign step" should change to 0.

testGuide.title: Finish the first mission
testGuide.detail: When the score screen appears the step becomes 1 and "Prologue Complete" pops.
